text:
Rae (Marketing): Draft is live in Drive. Need a fast pass: tighten hero, confirm benchmark phrasing, lock webinar timing, and inbound tracking. Doc: https://docs.google.com/d/launch-optimize

Ben (Content): Reading. Suggest hero: 'Up to 2x lower inference cost at production scale' but legal wants sentence case. Will avoid superlatives in social.

Claire (Legal): Change to sentence case: 'Up to 2x lower inference cost'. Add footnote linking to benchmark methodology and a short disclaimer 'results may vary'. Also flag any customer quotes needing written approval.

Hiro (Growth): Bench note: median 1.75x across 4 pilots, peak ~2x. We'll include method link in appendix. Webinar CTA should map to hubspot list.

Maya (Events): Proposed webinar: June 9 10am PT (40 min). Need presenter, bio, slide deck. I'll cap at 400 registrants and open rehearsal slot June 8 2pm PT.

Hiro (Growth): I can present the demo. Bio: 'Hiro Nakamura, Growth lead — previously infra at Nimbus, focuses on inference economics.'

Sam (Ops): HubSpot UTM plan: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=optimize_launch_jun2026. Map to list 554433. Form fields: company_size, primary_use_case, region. Automation to tag leads optimize_launch_jun2026; ETA: 12h.

Ben (Content): CTAs set: primary 'Register for demo', secondary 'Request a dedicated trial'. Social short variants drafted without absolutes. Quotes flagged in yellow where needed.

Claire (Legal): Approved edits and footnote added. Remember to remove any absolute language from social snippets.

Sam (Ops): Automation live and routing confirmed to list 554433.

Maya (Events): Invites sent, rehearsal scheduled, deck pin ready once Ben uploads. deploy-bot: Reminder set  Rehearsal June 8 14:00 PT.

Rae (Marketing): Publish target June 7 9am PT. Final checklist: legal done, quotes signed or anonymized, hubspot live, deck attached. React with :white_check_mark: when complete.

Hiro (Growth): :white_check_mark: slides and bio uploaded.

Ben (Content): :white_check_mark: content updates live; one quote pending outreach.

Sam (Ops): :white_check_mark: automation live.

Claire (Legal): :white_check_mark: legal pass complete.

Maya (Events): :white_check_mark: rehearsal & invites set.

Rae (Marketing): Thanks team  scheduling publish. If pending quote doesn't clear, we'll anonymize. Closing thread.
